## What a person using LiClone will notice

## Rules

- [ ] This pull request does one thing
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes that thing, if any code changed
- [ ] `package.json`, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, and `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` share one version
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, or rclone config
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
